description:
The hub's REST API as a rider's agent uses it, beside the agent channel.

``GET /api/v1/me/rungs`` answers the rider's rungs (``RungsOut``);
``POST /api/v1/me/rungs`` takes the rider's own ladder's shape
(``RungsSyncIn``) and answers as the ``GET`` does. ``x-paths`` names each
method's request and response model, taken from the endpoints themselves
(``api.hitchhike``); ``$defs`` holds the models.

A request to ``/v1`` (the OpenAI-compatible API) that the hub refuses is
answered with OpenAI's error shape, ``{"error": {"message", "type", "code",
"param"}}``; each ``code`` comes with one HTTP status, the pairs in
``x-openai-errors``. A client matches on the pair. A stream cut off after
its first bytes ends with an error event instead, whose code may also be
the relay's own.

Compatibility: answers are open (a client ignores fields it does not
know), so a new answer field or a new error code stays under ``/api/v1``.
Requests are closed (``additionalProperties`` false: the hub answers ``422``
to a field it does not know), so a new request field is not additive: an
older hub refuses it. A client sends one only to a hub that says it takes it
(a feature it publishes), or it comes with ``/api/v2``, as any breaking
change does.

Written by ``render_json_schema`` and checked in at
schemas/rider.schema.json.
title: mcgyvr hub rider API
